messages:
maria: FYI my PR #4823 (optimize-kv-cache) merged ~now, main CI just turned red. Smoke step failed and coverage report shows a -1.2% drop on core-serving-tests. Anyone free to eyeball? :eyes:

deploy-bot: [CI] main pipeline failed — smoke-gpu (job 7342). Link: https://ci.redwood/7342

ash: can you paste the failing test name + the last few lines of the log?

maria: failing tests: test_kv_prefetch, test_streaming_reconnect. paste logs: ```
FAIL test_kv_prefetch - AssertionError: expected 3 got 2
  File "tests/test_kv.py", line 87, in test_kv_prefetch
    assert prefetch_count == 3
E       AssertionError: 2 != 3

...stacktrace...
RuntimeError: grpc call failed: code=14: UNAVAILABLE
```

kevin: hmm looks like a flaky grpc/unavailable + prefetch count. @jen any recent changes to batching or retries?

jen: nothing in batching from me, but I did change a test fixture in PR #4818 yesterday related to seed and temp dir. That could affect ordering. Also I saw coverage dropped because a new branch in streaming code is not exercised.

ash: can someone rerun the job? if it goes green it's flaky. if red, bisect to the PR that caused it (likely 4823 or 4818).

kevin: I'll trigger rerun now. /rerun job 7342 :arrow_up_small:

deploy-bot: Job 7342 rerun queued (rerun-id 7343)

kevin: rerun finished — still red. I grabbed the matrix and it fails on linux-gpu-3 for streaming_reconnect with grpc timeout.

maria: ack. I can try a quick revert of PR 4823 if that speeds up mitigation.

sre-oncall: ping @kevin @maria — from infra side we've seen increased GRPC 14 spikes around the time of the merge. Could be transient infra noise but correlation looks real. Can you collect `journalctl` from the test node and `dmesg`? Also check kernel logs for OOM/kernel messages.

ash: I'll start a bisect across merges from last 6 merges (4815..4823). If someone can hold off on reverting for 10–15m that'd help.

maria: ok holding off. attaching small diff I suspect (a change to async prefetch worker scheduling): ```
diff
- await prefetch(..., parallel=1)
+ await prefetch(..., parallel=2)
```

jen: if parallel increased that could expose race in test fixture; we should also seed RNG or make test tolerant. Put a quick guard in test to retry on grpc UNAVAILABLE? Not ideal but buys time.

kevin: bisect started. provisional suspect PR 4823. assigning to @maria to try local reproduce, @jen to open test quick-fix PR if we confirm it's flaky.

maria: will reproduce locally, posting results in 10m.

kevin: noted. @sre-oncall flagging for possible infra flake, will coordinate.

maria: local repro: I can reproduce failing 2/10 runs with increased parallel prefetch. Stack shows grpc UNAVAILABLE coming from mocked-service during high concurrency.

jen: ok opening PR to add retry wrapper around test grpc calls + increase fixture timeout. PR #4830 created: https://git.redwood/pr/4830

ash: cool. once PR 4830 merges let's rerun smoke.

deploy-bot: New PR merged #4830 by jen

kevin: rerunning main smoke now (job 7344).

deploy-bot: Job 7344 queued

kevin: Job 7344 green. marking as flaky and adding test to flaky-tests.yaml for follow-up. We'll keep PR 4823 but follow up with more robust handling; postmortem planned.

maria: thanks all :)
